\textbf{\(c_1\) Scope and Deliverables Definition.}
The scope is better defined than many other WBS elements, as it clearly identifies the supplier (GDMS) and hardware categories (Embedded Crypto, NC3). However, it lacks a specific list of deliverables, preventing a "Strong" rating.\par\vspace{0.6em}
\textbf{\(c_2\) Schedule Planning and IMS-Loading Readiness.}
The description of "all product level design work" is not sufficient for schedule planning. It is not broken down into tasks, provides no basis for estimating durations, and has no defined workflow.\par\vspace{0.6em}
\textbf{\(c_3\) Cross-Product/Cross-Function Integration.}
The definition mentions "product-to-product design and integration" but fails to identify the specific interfaces or dependencies between the GDMS hardware and other subsystems. This is a significant gap in integration planning.\par\vspace{0.6em}
\end{minipage}
